title: Galatians
author: Paul the apostle.
historicalSetting: Galatians defends justification by faith in Christ apart from works of the law and calls believers to walk by the Spirit.
keyVerse: Galatians 2:20 — "I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me."
christFocus: Galatians centers on faith in Christ crucified, freedom from legalism, and life by the power of the Holy Spirit.
